features.name: Branded customer mobile app
features.adoption_note: Confirmed 2026-11-08: P1 dedicated salon-branded customer Android app, MAWID-owned/operated publishing with zero salon store-account work; shared source/manifests, one app per brand assumption, two-brand validation. Central eligibility/policy and first repeatable release path are P1. P4 scales fleet automation. iOS not committed.

features.name: Shop branding configuration
features.adoption_note: P1: controlled branding fields; P4: reusable builder with preview and versioning.

features.name: Branded booking website
features.adoption_note: P1: hosted shop page; P4: domain setup and self-service publishing.

features.name: Booking widgets
features.adoption_note: P4: begin with a button/link, then an embedded flow using the same booking engine.

features.name: QR booking and posters
features.adoption_note: P1: one stable QR/link per shop, with campaign attribution.

features.name: Shop and professional booking links
features.adoption_note: P1: shareable shop and professional URLs; retain selection through booking.

features.name: Google booking entry
features.adoption_note: P1: ordinary booking URL where supported; P4: assess deeper integration separately.

features.name: Professional lookbooks
features.adoption_note: P2: small image portfolio with captions and a professional-specific booking action.

features.name: Core booking management
features.adoption_note: P1: one authoritative server-side booking service used by every interface.

features.name: Booking approval policies
features.adoption_note: P1: manual approval by default. Later: automatic approval for members and regulars, with shop-controlled eligibility rules.

features.name: Staff schedules and availability
features.adoption_note: P1: persist them with permission checks and availability revalidation.

features.name: Staff service and duration overrides
features.adoption_note: P2: service overrides and explicit price-visibility settings.

features.name: Service add-ons
features.adoption_note: P2: select extras and recompute both duration and availability.

features.name: Service combinations and packages
features.adoption_note: P2: fixed-duration combinations first. Prepaid visit bundles require separate entitlement work.

features.name: Pricing and schedule gap rules
features.adoption_note: P2: configurable increments/buffers; defer complex price rules until demanded.

features.name: Recurring appointments
features.adoption_note: P2: preview conflicts for each occurrence and permit per-occurrence changes.

features.name: Staff-entered appointments
features.adoption_note: P1: manual booking and status capture, without financial checkout.

features.name: Walk-in queue
features.adoption_note: P2: staff-operated queue using the booking capacity model.

features.name: Future appointment waitlist
features.adoption_note: P2: service/staff/time preferences and an invitation to claim a slot.

features.name: Self-check-in kiosk
features.adoption_note: P2: add after staff-operated queue rules stabilize.

features.name: TV appointment and queue board
features.adoption_note: P2: optional read-only display with ticket/initials and expiring display access.

features.name: Mobile barber and house calls
features.adoption_note: P5 or separate vertical: add only after demand; model travel time and service areas.

features.name: Owner dashboard
features.adoption_note: P1: operational metrics tied to stored events; revenue only after a financial ledger exists.

features.name: Staff business workspace
features.adoption_note: Confirmed 2026-11-08: P1 one shared MAWID management Android app plus web management portal from the first pilot, distinct management application identity and server-authorized workspace/role access. P4 only later expansion; both initial surfaces are required.

features.name: Multiple business locations
features.adoption_note: P1: model organization/location separately; P4: operate multiple branches after demand.

features.name: Identity and access permissions
features.adoption_note: P1: owner, manager/reception, professional, and customer permissions, enforced by server.

features.name: Customer records and preferences
features.adoption_note: P1: minimal customer record; P2: structured preferences and consented notes.

features.name: Client insights
features.adoption_note: P3: explainable visit/return indicators first; financial insights after reliable payment data.

features.name: Operational reporting and exports
features.adoption_note: P1: tenant-scoped exports and event history; P2: useful owner reports.

features.name: Assisted data migration
features.adoption_note: P1: assisted onboarding with preview, duplicate checks, and rollback for an authorized import.

features.name: Guided shop onboarding
features.adoption_note: P1: guided checklist ending in a successful two-device test booking.

features.name: Transactional notifications
features.adoption_note: P1: one dependable transactional channel plus a fallback; add channels by measured need.

features.name: Marketing campaigns
features.adoption_note: P3: opt-in campaigns to explicit customer segments, with suppression and spend limits.

features.name: Notification templates and delivery
features.adoption_note: P1: event templates, provider status, deduplication, retries, and visible failures.

features.name: Loyalty points
features.adoption_note: P3: one simple earn/redeem rule, with reversal for corrections.

features.name: Personal rewards and discounts
features.adoption_note: P3: add only the reward types pilots understand and can afford.

features.name: Shop memberships
features.adoption_note: P5: launch after billing and service-credit accounting; distinguish salon memberships from Mawid subscriptions.

features.name: Pay-in-shop workflow
features.adoption_note: P1: support booking without collecting money; optional manual paid/unpaid status once agreed.

features.name: Online payments and deposits
features.adoption_note: P5: one locally viable provider and complete refund/reconciliation flow.

features.name: Cancellation and no-show fees
features.adoption_note: P5: clear customer policy, reviewable charge, and refund/dispute handling.

features.name: POS and card terminals
features.adoption_note: P5: validate hardware/support economics before a counter checkout product.

features.name: Individual staff payment accounts
features.adoption_note: P5: clarify merchant responsibility and independent-professional demand before implementing.

features.name: Product catalog and commerce
features.adoption_note: P5: small catalog and collection first; add after checkout proves useful.

features.name: Inventory and fulfilment
features.adoption_note: P5: stock movements, returns, and fulfilment; do not infer warehouse/accounting depth.

features.name: Booking API
features.adoption_note: P1: internal service contract; P4: documented external API with scoped access.

features.name: Chatbot and voice booking integrations
features.adoption_note: P4: integrate through the same validated booking service. A possible integration is not a turnkey assistant.

features.name: Phone verification and abuse controls
features.adoption_note: P1: real identity and rate limits; review abuse controls without relying on IP alone.

features.name: Mawid subscription and pricing
features.adoption_note: After the first pilot: discuss the commercial offer, including subscription and messaging allowances.

features.name: Onboarding and support service
features.adoption_note: P1: named onboarding/support owner, realistic response hours, and issue escalation.

features.name: Referral and ambassador programs
features.adoption_note: After retention: start with shop-to-shop referrals; model commissions before promising them.

distribution_decision.source: Saeed's direct instruction in MAWID engineering-plan update conversation
distribution_decision.status: product direction confirmed; technical feasibility/store outcomes unverified
